name: Switch Cumulus
summary: Firmware for Switch Electric's three-phase LoRaWAN prepaid energy meter on the STM32WL55: Ed25519-signed usage reports, remote load control, rich telemetry and fail-safe firmware updates over the air.
description: Switch Cumulus measures energy with an ATM90E36A metering IC and reports Ed25519-signed, nonce-protected usage readings over LoRaWAN (OTAA, Class C). A backend can switch the customer's load through a relay with downlinks. A custom bootloader installs signed firmware updates sent over LoRaWAN FUOTA, survives power cuts mid-install and rolls back automatically if the new firmware cannot join the network. Optional FPort 4 telemetry carries every phase's voltage, current, active and reactive power, power factor, neutral current, frequency and temperature for the Switch M3TERS dashboard.
highlights: Signed-image bootloader: backup, power-cut-safe install, automatic rollback, downgrades refused
Device-unique Ed25519 key generated from the hardware TRNG; signed reports with server-issued nonces for replay protection
Three-phase metering with selectable phase mode, run-time PGA settings and guided serial calibration
Reliability: no heap, bounds-safe printf, stack guard, crash reports, watchdog and automatic LoRaWAN re-join
